title: Research formulation, gates, and assets
summary: Research formulation compiles typed claims, literature, experiments, ablations, gates, and concrete assets without redundant reciprocal edges.

assertions.description: Claims and literature compile into the required formulation transition and typed downstream obligations.
Expected-red gate authoring may finish, but downstream readiness remains blocked until a compatible concrete asset and typed verifier pass.
Claim/experiment, claim/ablation, and gate applicability reciprocity use one bidirectional relationship, not two circular declarations.
